messages:
Jordan: heads up — PR #8427 ready but blocked on design sign-off. I linked the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8427. Can someone confirm we have an RFC or spec to reference? I'm missing the RFC link in PR description.
Mira: I tried to find an RFC but couldn't. Any SLO/latency delta numbers? Need that for arch review. :eyes:
Lee: pinging arch/design — Jordan, can you add the RFC link? If we don't have one, please add a brief design note in the PR describing fallback behavior and canary plan.
Jordan: sorry — working on it. Short note: change routes to fall back to small-model-lex when dedicated pool saturated, expected p99 +10ms, cost approx -2% token. Canary: 1% traffic for 24h. Will add RFC link if we land one. ETA ~1h.
Mira: that's helpful. Also need test matrix + rollout rollback criteria. Add to PR as checklist.
Lee: if you can paste the sensitive bits here I'll eyeball quickly. If this is covered by RFC-209 (kv-cache-routing), post the link.
Jordan: actually RFC-209 covers some but not the fallback policy. I'm drafting RFC-311 (kv-routing-fallback). Draft here: https://docs.internal.redwood/rfc/rfc-311-draft — it's a draft but I'll add the link to the PR now. Note: draft needs arch ack.
Mira: OK please add `RFC: rfc-311` to the PR body and tag @mira @lee for arch ack. Once linked, we can set PR gate to arch-review and schedule a merge slot. :thumbsup:
Sam: quick question — does this change the model compatibility matrix? Do we need to update model-catalog entries? If yes, add that to the PR.
Jordan: yes — we need a compatibility flag and a migration step. I'll include migration notes and request @sam review for model-catalog changes.
deploy-bot: PR #8427 updated by Jordan — description changed.
Lee: skimmed the RFC draft. One request: add a short sequence diagram for request routing and a failure-flow example. After that, arch ack from me (pending minor nits).
Mira: leaving a formal +1 once RFC link is in and the checklist items are ticked. If you want a faster path, add a feature flag + TTL-based rollback in the rollout plan.
Jordan: added RFC link, sequence diagram, and updated checklist (test matrix, rollback criteria, migration steps). Requesting arch ack.
Mira: arch ack from me — thanks. @Lee can you give final LGTM?
Lee: LGTM. Scheduling merge window for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Marking PR ready to merge. :merge:
Sam: approved for the model-catalog changes, will follow up on the migration runbook after merge.
Jordan: thanks all — merging after scheduled window unless any last objections.
